Polizeikessel, Pyrotechnik, Wasserwerfer : Anti-Rüstungsdemo in Köln Stand: 05.09.2026, 16:45 Uhr Bei einer Demo in Köln gegen die Rüstungsindustrie zünden Demonstrierende immer wieder Pyrotechnik. Der Zug wurde mehrfach unterbrochen, die Polizei ist mit Wasserwerfern im Einsatz. Von Estella Mazur und Oliver Köhler Laut Polizei demonstrieren gerade rund 1.000 Menschen in der Kölner Innenstadt gegen die Rüstungsindustrie. Offenbar werden immer wieder Feuerwerkskörper gezündet. Darauf reagiert die Polizei, indem sie die Demonstrierenden einkesselt. Der Demozug wird immer wieder gestoppt. Es gibt kleinere Rangeleien zwischen Einsatzkräften und den Demonstrierenden. Die Polizei ist mit zwei Wasserwerfern vor Ort. Wasserwerfer der Polizei im Einsatz in Köln. Bildquelle: WDR/ Oliver Köhler Es kommen weiterhin Menschen dazu. Ursprünglich waren 400 Teilnehmende angemeldet worden. Sie fordern ein Ende der Waffenlieferungen, keine Wehrpflicht und ein Ende der Kriegseinsätze. Pyrotechnik gezündet - Polizei kesselt ein Schon im Vorfeld kam es zu einem Polizeieinsatz. Teilnehmende hatten bereits auf dem Weg zur Demo Pyrotechnik gezündet. Die Polizei hat daraufhin eine kleinere Gruppe eingekesselt und ihre Identitäten geprüft. Aufgerufen hat das Protestcamp "Rheinmetall Entwaffnen", das seit Dienstag am Grüngürtel zeltet. Nach der Auftaktkundgebung will die Demonstration bis 19 Uhr durch die Innenstadt ziehen. Bürgerinnen und Bürger müssen mit Verkehrsbeeinträchtigungen rechnen. Die Polizei stoppt diese Demonstrierenden auf dem Weg zur Kundgebung, weil aus der Gruppe Pyrotechnik gezündet worden sein soll. Bildquelle: WDR / Oliver Köhler Mehr als 1.000 Einsatzkräfte der Polizei Die Polizei ist mit verstärkten Kräften am Versammlungsort. Auch die Zugänge zur großen Einkaufsstraße in der umliegenden Umgebung werden von den Beamtinnen und Beamten bewacht. Seit Wochen hatten sie sich auf das Protestcamp und dessen Aktionen vorbereitet. Rund 1.000 Einsatzkräfte von außerhalb unterstützten die Kölner Polizei dabei. Der Führungsstab ist rund um die Uhr besetzt. Mehrere Zusammenstöße im Vorfeld Am Donnerstag war es zu einem größeren Polizeieinsatz gekommen. Etwa 100 Mitglieder des Bündnisses Rheinmetall Entwaffnen hatten die Zufahrt zu einer Bundeswehr-Kaserne in Köln -Longerich blockiert . Die Polizei hatte die Versammlung aufgelöst, weil sie nicht angemeldet und der Großteil vermummt war. Weil die Teilnehmenden nicht gehen wollten, zog sich der Einsatz bis in den späten Nachmittag. Das Bündnis wirft der Polizei übermäßige Aggression vor. Beim ersten Protestcamp im August 2025 hatten Angehörige des Bündnisses "Rheinmetall Entwaffnen" unter anderem vor einem Gebäude der Bundeswehr und in der Nähe des Privathauses von Rheinmetall-Chef Armin Papperger protestiert. Auch damals war es zu gewaltsamen Auseinandersetzungen zwischen Polizei und Demonstrierenden gekommen. Die juristische Aufarbeitung ist noch nicht abgeschlossen. September 1946 - Freddie Mercury wird geboren Macho im Unterhemd, Gentleman im adretten Anzug, Primadonna mit Seidenschleier - die Wandlungsfähigkeit des Sängers der Rockband " Queen ", Freddie Mercury , begeistert seine Fans. Ihm macht es auch nichts aus, sich mit langen Fingernägeln zu präsentieren. Das sehe zwar lächerlich aus, aber es funktioniere. Der Brite genießt das Rampenlicht und die Selbstinszenierung: "Auf der Bühne bin ich sehr stark, keiner kann mich da kriegen." Neben seiner harten Seite habe er aber auch eine weiche, sagt Mercury : "Wenn mich die richtige Person erwischt, wird sie herausfinden, dass ich sehr verletzlich bin und ein richtiges Baby sein kann." Kindheit in Indien Mercury wird am 5. September 1946 als Farrokh Bulsara auf der Insel Sansibar geboren. Der Sohn eines britischen Regierungsbeamten indischer Herkunft wächst in Indien auf. Einer seiner Lehrer im Internat entdeckt Bulsaras musikalisches Talent - mit der Schulband " The Hectics " feiert er erste kleine Bühnenerfolge. Nach seiner Schulzeit in Mumbai wohnt seine Familie erneut in Sansibar und flüchtet nach einer Revolution 1964 nach England, wo er später Grafik-Design studiert. Ende der 1960er Jahre gründet er zusammen mit Brian May (Gitarre), Roger Taylor (Schlagzeug) und John Deacon (Bass) die Band " Smile ", aus der 1970 " Queen " wird. Dem gleichnamigen Debütalbum vom Juli 1973 folgt ein Jahr später die Single " Seven Seas of Rhye ", die die englische Hitparade erobert. 1975 bringt ein sechs Minuten langer Song den internationalen Durchbruch: " Bohemian Rapsody ". Die Band kreiert unter Mercurys Einfluss ihren eigenen Bombastic-Sound , der Hard-Rock-Gitarren mit Opern-Gesang und Disco-Rhythmen kombiniert. Ein Hit folgt dem anderen, darunter " We are the Champions " und " We will rock you ". Die späten Queen -Konzerte enden mit der englischen Hymne " God save the Queen ", bei der Mercury mit Krone und im Hermelin auf der Bühne steht. Auf den Tourneen rund um die Welt schließen sich dem Bühnenspektakel oft mehrtägige Feste an. Zu den Höhepunkten gehören der Auftritt 1981 in Sao Paulo vor über 230.000 Fans und die Beteiligung am "Live-Aid "-Konzert vier Jahre später. "70 werden wäre langweilig" Sex, Alkohol und Kokain - Mercury führt einen exzessiven Lebensstil. Dann die niederschmetternde Nachricht: Aids. Doch der Star lässt sich nichts anmerken, macht sogar Scherze über das, was nach dem Leben kommt oder nicht: "Ich habe ganz bestimmt nicht den Ehrgeiz, 70 zu werden. Das wäre doch langweilig." Erst einen Tag vor seinem Tod erfährt die Öffentlichkeit offiziell von seiner Krankheit. Mercury stirbt am 24. November 1991 im Alter von 45 Jahren in London an einer Lungenentzündung. Ratsentscheid gestoppt : Darum feiern Patienten diesen Bürgermeister Stand: 03.09.2026, 20:41 Uhr Spektakuläre Entscheidung im Rat in Kalletal: Erst wird dem Ärztehaus MVZ das überlebenswichtige Darlehen abgelehnt. Dann stoppt der Bürgermeister den gerade gefassten Beschluss wieder. Ein übervoller Saal mit emotionalen Zuhörern, überraschende Beschlüsse bei geheimer Wahl, eine spektakuläre Wende - und am Ende stehende Ovationen für den Bürgermeister: Das, was gestern im Rat Kalletal zum Fortbestand des medizinischen Versorgungszentrums ( MVZ ) entschieden wurde, hatte alles, was es zum lokalpolitischen Drama braucht. Das Ärztehaus am Ort gibt es noch nicht lange. Um in den ersten Jahren über die Runden zu kommen, braucht es Finanzspritzen. Die Gemeinde hatte schon einmal ein Darlehen gewährt. Jetzt sollte ein weiteres über 500.000 Euro dazu kommen. Dafür kämpfte Bürgermeister Mario Hecker (parteilos), unterstützt von SPD und Grünen . Das MVZ in Kalletal muss weiterhin auf das Darlehen warten. Bildquelle: WDR / Thomas Wöstmann 15:15-Patt nach geheimer Abstimmung Zu Beginn der Ratssitzung beantragt die Fraktion UKB eine geheime Abstimmung. Und die führt dann zur ersten großen Überraschung. Es gibt ein Stimmenpatt: 15 Ja- und 15 Nein-Stimmen. Das Darlehen ist damit abgelehnt. Offenbar haben damit mehrere Ratsmitglieder über Nacht ihre Meinung geändert. Denn abends zuvor hatten SPD, Grüne, UKB und Bürgermeister im Hauptausschuss noch für das Darlehen gestimmt. Nur die CDU war dagegen. Es folgen ungläubiges Staunen und deutliche Unmutsäußerungen im Publikum. Anfang des Jahres hatte es ein Bürgerbegehren für das MVZ gegeben. Jetzt droht das Aus. MVZ Kalletal: Bürgermeister stoppt Entscheidung Dann meldet sich der Bürgermeister zu Wort. Er habe in den elf Jahren im Amt nie an so etwas gedacht. Aber jetzt werde er Widerspruch gegen den gerade erfolgten Ratsbeschluss einlegen, weil er das Wohl der Gemeinde gefährdet sehe - ein sehr außergewöhnlicher Schritt. "Paragraph 54, Absatz 1, der Gemeindeordnung ermöglicht es dem Bürgermeister gegen einen gefassten Beschluss des Rates Widerspruch einzulegen," erklärt Bürgermeister Hecker gegenüber dem WDR , "wenn er das Wohl der Gemeinde gefährdet sieht." "Wenn 2.500 Leute keinen Hausarzt mehr haben und 2.000 Patienten keinen Zahnarzt mehr haben und wenn unter Umständen mehr als 500.000 Euro Darlehen verloren sind - einen größeren Schaden kann man sich eigentlich nicht vorstellen, oder?" Mario Hecker, Bürgermeister Kalletal Es folgen: lauter Jubel von fast allen Bürgern im Saal, dazu stehende Ovationen. Auch SPD und Grüne stehen auf und applaudieren. CDU und UKB schweigen betreten. Düsseldorfer Caravan Salon : Was hinter dem Dachzelt-Trend steckt Stand: 01.09.2026, 17:55 Uhr Erstmals haben Dachzelte beim Düsseldorfer Caravan Salon ihren eigenen Messebereich - ein Trend, der nicht ganz billig ist. Von Nora Schuster " Wir waren in diesem Sommer mit unserem Wohnwagen in Schottland ", erzählt Saskia Nicola. Doch der Platz für die fünfköpfige Familie, die auf Mallorca lebt, wird immer knapper. " Deshalb wollen wir uns ein Dachzelt anschaffen, damit die Kinder dort ihren eigenen Schlafplatz haben und sich nicht alle im Wohnwagen tummeln. " Die drei Kinder Maria, Theo und Jakob freuen sich darauf. Maria, Theo und Jakob werden im nächsten Urlaub vielleicht im Dachzelt schlafen. Bildquelle: Nora Schuster-Gröters Viele Zelte stecken voller Technik Es gibt mittlerweile Mechanismen, die es möglich machen, ein Dachzelt ohne fremde Hilfe auf das Autodach zu hieven. Außerdem bauen sich manche Modelle innerhalb weniger Minuten selbstständig auf. Händler Michael Krämer von der Firma Camp werk aus Velbert findet das Modell am tollsten, das mit einem großen Fenster punkten kann. " Da kannst du die Nordlichter beim Einschlafen beobachten ", schwärmt Krämer. 25.000 Euro kostet der Camping-Anhänger, den Konstantin Ambrosi ausstellt. Vom ausgestatteten Innenraum kann man direkt ins Dachzelt nach oben steigen. " Das ist der Trend: private PKW zum Camper zu machen. Die Dachzelte passen auf jedes Auto oder auf die Anhänger, sind gemütlich und können durch eine Außenküche erweitert werden. " Es gibt sie wirklich: Dachzelt- Influencer Hobby und vielleicht Nebenjob: Architektin Sandra Eberz und Außendienstler Mario Schwark lieben ihre Urlaube mit dem Dachzelt und berichten auf ihrem Instagram-Kanal "@die.zwei.mit.dem.dachzelt" von ihren Reisen. " Glamping ", also Camping auf luxuriöse Weise, lehnen die beiden jungen Leute ab. Sie haben auch kein Vorzelt, wenn sie durch nordische Gefilde reisen. " Gerade waren wir in Norwegen, das war pures Abenteuer ", schwärmt Sandra Eberz. " Im Zelt fehlt uns an nichts ", sagt Lebensgefährte Mario Schwark. " Da ist es kuschelig wie in einer Höhle - minimalistisch, aber gemütlich! " Sandra Eberz und Mario Schwark reisen mit ihrem Dachzelt und berichten darüber in sozialen Netzwerken. Bildquelle: Nora Schuster-Gröters Reisen mit dem Zelt auf dem Dach - nicht ganz billig Während das Caravaning und Camping mit großen Mobilen längst kein Billig-Urlaub mehr ist, kann sich auch das Reisen mit dem Dachzelt nicht unbedingt jeder leisten: Die Basismodelle kosten in der Regel zwischen 1.500 und 5.000 Euro. Es gibt aber Hartschalen-Typen, die noch wesentlich kostspieliger sind, und auch Vorzelte, Außenküchen und Kochzubehör können je nach Qualität schnell in die Tausende gehen - je komfortabler, desto teurer. Mieten statt Kaufen Ein Dachzelt ist eine nicht ganz günstige Investition. Wer unsicher ist, ob das Reisen auf diese Art etwas für einen ist, muss nicht sofort kaufen. Christian Schulz aus Bochum bietet Dachzelte zur Miete an: " Das kostet ungefähr 30 Euro pro Nacht und dann kann's losgehen nach Afrika, Skandinavien oder an den Bodensee. " Überall dort war er in den vergangenen Jahren zusammen mit seiner Familie und wurde mehr und mehr Fan von Dachzelten. Minimalistisch, aber gemütlich - so kann es in einem Dachzelt aussehen. title: Vorschau: Kommissar Dupin - Bretonischer Stolz • Fernsehfilm Deutschland 2017
description: HR am 06.09.2026: Spielfilm Deutschland 2017 Die ehemalige Schauspiel-Diva Sophie Bandol entdeckt nachts eine Leiche. Aufgeschreckt ruft sie die Polizei, doch als diese eintrifft, ist die Leiche verschwunden. Handelt es sich um Auswüchse der Fantasie einer etwas kapriziösen Diva, wie Inspektor Kadeg vermutet? Kommissar Dupin sieht das anders. Dass es erst einmal keine Leiche gibt, bedeutet nicht, dass kein Verbrechen stattgefunden hat. Dupin vergräbt sich in die Ermittlungen und kommt auf die Spur eines vermissten schottischen Geschäftsmannes. Kurz darauf wird ein weiterer Toter gefunden, ebenfalls ein Schotte. Augenscheinlich hängen die beiden Todesfälle zusammen. Beide Männer waren kürzlich aus Schottland in die Bretagne gereist. Dupins Recherche führt ihn zu dem Austernzüchter Baptiste Kolenc und dem Geschäftsmann Matthieu Tordeux. Beide Männer haben etwas zu verbergen, doch die Wurzel des Verbrechens scheint noch weiter zurückzuliegen. Akribisch, wie es seine Art ist, versucht Dupin, das Geheimnis zu entschlüsseln, doch diese Zeit will ihm sein ungeduldiger Vorgesetzter Locmariaquer nicht geben und bringt Dupin in ernste Schwierigkeiten. text: How to Use Instagram Stories: Complete 2026 Guide Skip to main content Log in Back to blog # TIPS & TRICKS # PRODUCT How to use Instagram Stories: The complete 2026 guide Posted on Takeaways Whether you're capturing a quick laugh with friends, hyping up your weekend plans or just sharing what's playing in your headphones, Instagram Stories is the place to do it. Stories are live for 24 hours and sit at the top of your feed, giving you a low-pressure way to share what you're up to in the moment. This guide covers everything you need to know about how to use Instagram Stories: from posting your first one to using stickers, saving favorites to Highlights and scheduling Stories ahead of time. If you're new to Stories or just want to get more out of them, start here. What are Instagram Stories? Instagram Stories are short, vertical photo or video posts designed to be temporary. They disappear after 24 hours, appear at the top of your feed inside circles around your friends' profile photos and are built for sharing moments as they happen: the meal you just made, a song you can't stop replaying, the view from your morning walk. Unlike a regular post, Stories are a casual place to share everyday moments, express yourself creatively and connect with friends. You can keep it simple with a quick photo or go all in with stickers, music, text and effects. There's no pressure to make it perfect since they only last a day. Stories also connect to the rest of Instagram. You can explore Stories features like Highlights, polls, music and effects, or use Stories to share clips from your Instagram Reels . They're also a great place to test ideas before posting something more polished. For deeper dives on specific moves, Stories tips and tricks is a good companion read. How do you post a story on Instagram? Posting a story takes about three taps. Here's the full flow: Open Instagram and tap the + in the top-right corner, or swipe right from your feed to open the Stories camera. Capture something with the camera, or tap the gallery icon in the bottom-left to upload a photo or video from your camera roll. Edit your story. Add stickers from the sticker tray, type with the text tool, draw with the brush or apply a filter or effect. Tap Your story at the bottom to share with everyone who follows you. Or tap Close friends to share only with the people on your Close Friends list. You can also share directly to specific people via DM. Once your story is live, swipe up to see who's viewed it. Share with Close Friends for unfiltered moments Not every story is meant for everyone. Your Close Friends list is a great way to share unfiltered hot takes, random thoughts or moments you'd only show your inner circle. You control who's on the list and can update it anytime. To set up or edit your Close Friends list, go to your profile, tap the menu icon and select Close friends . Add or remove people as you like. When you post, just tap Close friends instead of Your story and only those people will see it. Tip: If you're not sure what to share, start with something simple: a photo from your week, a song on repeat or a quick "ask me anything" using the questions sticker. How long do Instagram Stories last? Instagram Stories last for 24 hours from the moment you post them. After that, they disappear from your profile and from your friends' feeds. Stories are designed to be temporary, which makes them a low-pressure way to share without overthinking. This is different from a regular Instagram post, which stays on your profile until you archive or delete it. A single story clip can be up to 60 seconds long. If your video is longer, Instagram automatically splits it into multiple back-to-back story clips so the full thing plays through. You can post as many stories in a day as you want. There's no daily limit. Your stories are saved in your Archive After 24 hours, your stories don't disappear forever. Instagram automatically saves them to your Stories Archive , a private space only you can see. This turns your stories into a kind of visual diary, perfect for reliving past moments. To find your Archive, go to your profile, tap the menu icon in the top-right and select Archive . From there you can browse past stories by date and add any of them to Highlights. If you want a story to stay visible on your profile beyond 24 hours, save it to your Highlights . They stay on your profile until you remove them. How do you save Instagram Stories to Highlights? Stories disappear after 24 hours, but you can save stories to Highlights to keep your favorites on your profile permanently. There are two ways to add a story to a Highlight: From an active story: Open one of your current stories, tap the three dot menu first, then tap Highlight at the bottom and either add it to an existing Highlight or create a new one. From your archive: Go to your profile, tap the menu icon in the top-right and tap Archive . Find any past story (Instagram archives all your stories automatically by default) and add it to a Highlight from there. Highlights show up as round covers under your profile bio and stay there until you remove them. Use them to organize your favorite moments to share with others and look back on: travel, recipes, big projects or ongoing series. Tip: Give each Highlight a clear name and a custom cover image so they're easy to browse at a glance. Templates and layout If you're not sure what to share or want to post without too much effort, templates and layout tools are your friend. They give you a starting point so you can focus on the content, not the design. Add Yours Templates Templates are ready-made designs you can fill in with your own photos and text. You'll find them in a few places: When creating a story, tap Add Yours at the top of the gallery selection page to see trending prompts and templates. In the sticker tray, tap the Add Yours sticker to create your own prompt or start a new template that friends can respond to. Templates are great when you want to join a trend or just need a creative nudge. Layout The Layout feature in the camera lets you split a single story frame into a grid of up to 6 photos. Tap Layout in the side toolbar before capturing, choose your grid style and shoot or upload photos for each panel. This works well for before-and-afters, photo dumps or showing multiple angles of the same moment. Collage For something more dynamic, try Collage . This AI-powered tool creates animated collages from 5 or more photos. It automatically arranges your images with movement and style, turning a batch of photos into something fun to watch. Open the Stories camera, select multiple photos from your gallery and look for the Collage option. It's a quick way to share a lot without creating multiple story slides. Photo stickers The photo sticker lets you layer additional photos onto your background, which is great for combining multiple shots into one frame. Open the sticker tray and tap the photo sticker to add images on top of your main photo or video. For more on combining these tools, check out collage and layout tips . Tip: If you don't know what to post, start with a template. It takes the guesswork out of creating and helps you share more often. Restyle your stories with AI If you want to transform your photos and videos without much effort, try restyling with AI. This feature uses Meta AI to apply creative styles to your story content, giving you a fresh look in a few taps. Film presets Film presets give your stories a cool vintage or analog vibe. Choose from styles that mimic classic film stocks, complete with grain, color shifts and that nostalgic feel. It's a quick way to make an everyday photo look like it was shot on a disposable camera. Illustration styles Turn your photos into illustrations or stylized artwork. These presets can make your selfie look like a sketch, a watercolor painting or a graphic novel panel. Text restyle AI can also restyle the text on your stories. Type your text, tap the A* icon and choose from creative presets or describe how you want your text to look. It's a fast way to match your words to the mood of your story without designing anything from scratch. Check back often as we’re constantly adding more effects for you to get creative with your stories. For more on how this works, check out restyling your Stories with Meta AI. Tip: Try a Film preset on a simple photo of your coffee or your walk outside. Sometimes the most ordinary shots look best with a little analog warmth. What features and stickers can you use on Instagram Stories? The sticker tray is where Stories really come alive. Open it by tapping the smiley sticker icon in the top toolbar after you've captured or uploaded your photo or video. From there, you'll see categories for music, GIFs, location, mentions and more, plus newer additions like Add Yours, Cutouts and Effects. Below are the sticker types most people use, with how to find them and ideas for what to do with them. For more inspiration, browse creative story ideas and sticker ideas for your stories . Music stickers Music stickers add a song to your story, complete with album art or a spinning vinyl design. Open the sticker tray and select Music . Search for a song or browse trending tracks, then drag the highlighted lyrics to the moment in the song you want to share. Once you've added a track, you can tap the vinyl design to choose from different visual styles: sticker, lyrics-only or full cover. The vinyl spins on the story and friends can "scratch" it for a fun audio cue. Finding the right song: If you're not sure what to add, check the For You section in the music picker. It suggests tracks based on what you've listened to and what's popular with your friends. You can also browse by mood or genre to find something that fits. For more on how this works, see music for Instagram Stories . Polls and quizzes The poll sticker lets you ask a question with two answer options. Friends tap to vote and you can watch the results update in real time. The quiz sticker works similarly but lets you add four answer choices with one correct answer, handy for "guess where I am" or "name this song" prompts. To add either, open the sticker tray, tap Poll or Quiz and customize the question and answers. Both stickers are one of the easiest ways to get friends interacting with your story. Link stickers The link sticker lets you point friends to a website, article, product or any URL outside Instagram. Tap the sticker tray, tap Link and paste in your URL. You can customize the sticker text to make the link feel inviting, like "shop the look," "read the recipe" or "watch the trailer." Anyone watching your story can tap the sticker to open the link. Learn more about how to add a link sticker or how to share links in your stories for different use cases. Add Yours stickers Add Yours is a sticker that turns your story into a prompt other people can respond to. Add an Add Yours sticker with a prompt ("show me your favorite mug," "post a song that lifts your mood") and friends can tap to add their own response, which then chains together into a thread of stories anyone can join. You can find Add Yours prompts in two places: In the sticker tray: Tap the Add Yours sticker to create your own prompt or template. From the gallery: When creating a story, tap Add Yours at the top of the gallery selection page to see popular prompts and jump right in. Countdown stickers The countdown sticker lets you build anticipation for an event: a concert, a birthday, a launch or just the end of the week. To create one, add the sticker, set the date and time and customize the countdown name and color. Friends can also subscribe to your countdown and get a notification when time's up. Questions sticker The questions sticker opens up a space for friends to send you replies. Add the sticker with a prompt ("ask me anything," "what should I cook tonight," "drop your music recs") and friends can type a response that comes to you privately. You can then share their response anonymously in a follow-up story. It's one of the most flexible stickers for sparking real conversations. Other stickers worth exploring Other stickers worth trying include the emoji slider for measuring sentiment, Frames for collaborative photo moments and Cutouts for turning your photos into custom stickers you can layer onto future stories . How do you schedule Instagram Stories? If you want to plan a story ahead of time, whether for a launch, a coordinated moment or just because you'll be busy when the time comes, you can schedule it through Instagram's built-in scheduling tools. To schedule a story: Open the Stories camera and create your story as usual. Before sharing, tap the more options menu (the three dots). Tap Schedule , choose your date and time and confirm. Your scheduled story will appear in your scheduled content list and Instagram will post it automatically at the chosen time. Scheduling is currently available to accounts that meet Instagram's eligibility requirements . The path may shift as the app updates. Frequently asked questions How long do Instagram Stories last? Stories last 24 hours from the moment you post them, then disappear from your profile and friends' feeds. They're automatically saved to your Stories Archive, where you can view them later or add them to Highlights. To keep a story visible on your profile longer, save it to a Highlight. Can you see who views your Instagram Stories? Yes. Open one of your active stories and swipe up on the screen to see the full list of viewers, ordered by recency. Does Instagram notify when you screenshot a story? No. Instagram does not send a notification when someone screenshots a regular story. Disappearing photos and videos sent in DMs are the exception and will trigger a notification. How do I mute someone's stories? Long-press the person's profile photo at the top of your feed (in the Stories tray) and tap Mute . Their stories will move to the end of your tray and stop showing up at the front. You can unmute them anytime from the same menu. How do I change the background color on my story? Take or upload a photo, then tap the brush icon to open the draw tool. Pick a color, then tap and hold anywhere on the screen and the entire background will fill with that color. From there, you can erase parts to reveal the photo underneath or layer in text and stickers on top. Can you post a story from a computer? Yes. Open instagram.com in a browser, sign in and click your profile photo in the top-left to open the story creator. You can upload a photo or video and add basic edits, though some features (like certain stickers) are mobile-only. Open Stories and start creating Instagram Stories work because they give you a creative, casual space to share your day and connect with friends. The song you can't stop playing, the meal you're proud of, the walk that surprised you, the inside joke only your group chat understands. You don't need a plan, you don't need a brand and you don't need a huge following. You just need something worth sharing for the next 24 hours. If you've been meaning to try a sticker you haven't used yet, experiment with AI restyle or build a Highlight you've been putting off, open Stories and give it a shot. The lower the stakes, the better the story. encyclopedia Main help page for Wikipedia This page provides help with the most common questions about Wikipedia . You can also use the search box below Help Wikipedia Or browse the Help menu or the Help directory to find help pages. For interactive assistance related to using and editing Wikipedia, see the help desk and the Teahouse . Read or find an article The Readers' FAQ and our about page contain the most commonly sought information about Wikipedia. For simple searches, there is a search bar at the top of every page. Type what you are looking for in the box. Suggested matches will appear in a dropdown list. Select any page in the list to go to that page. Or, select the " Search " button, or press ↵ Enter , to go to a full search result. For advanced searches, see Help:Searching . There are other ways to browse and explore Wikipedia articles; many can be found at Wikipedia:Contents . See our disclaimer for cautions about Wikipedia's limitations. For mobile access , press the mobile view link at the very bottom of every desktop view page. Edit an article Contributing is easy: see how to edit a page . For a quick summary on participating, see contributing to Wikipedia , and for a friendly tutorial, see our introduction . The Simplified Ruleset outlines our key policies and guidelines, while the Simplified Manual of Style and Cheatsheet can remind you of basic wiki markup . Be bold in improving articles! When adding facts, please provide references so others may verify them. If you are affiliated with the article subject, please see our conflict of interest guide . The simple guide to vandalism cleanup can help you undo malicious edits. If you're looking for places you can help out, the Task Center is the place to go, or check out what else is happening at the community portal . You can practice editing and experiment in a sandbox your sandbox . Report a problem with an article If there is a problem with an article about yourself, a family member, a friend or a colleague, please read Biographies of living persons/Help . If you spot a problem with an article, you can fix it directly, by clicking on the " Edit " link at the top of that page. See the "edit an article" section of this page for more information. If you don't feel ready to fix the article yourself, post a message on the article's talk page . This will bring the matter to the attention of others who work on that article. There is a " Talk " link at the beginning of every article page. You can contact us . If it's an article about you or your organization, see Contact us – Subjects . Create a new article or upload media Check Your first article to see if your topic is appropriate, then the Article wizard will walk you through creating the article. Once you have created an article, see Writing better articles for guidance on how to improve it and what to include (like reference citations ). For contributing images, audio or video files, see the Introduction to uploading images . Then the Upload wizard will guide you through that process. FAQ and interactive help Answers to common problems can be found at frequently asked questions . Or check out where to ask questions or make comments . New users should seek help at the Teahouse if they're having problems while editing Wikipedia. More complex questions can be posed at the Help desk . Volunteers will respond as soon as they're able. Or ask for help on your talk page and a volunteer will visit you there! You can get live help with editing in the help chatroom . For help with technical issues, ask at the Village pump . Factual questions If searching Wikipedia has not answered your question ( for example, questions like "Which country has the world's largest fishing fleet?" ), try the Reference Desk . Volunteers there will attempt to answer your questions on any topic, or point you toward the information you need. Tip of the day How to use Wikipedia Offline: XOWA There is a way to have Wikipedia loaded on your computer so that you can view it when you don't have access to the Internet. It's called XOWA , and it's compatible with Microsoft Windows , OSX , Linux and Android . XOWA allows users to download and import their own copy of Wikipedia using official database dumps , or by special hosted database files specifically created for use within XOWA. The application is designed to accurately display Wikipedia content through its own built-in browser, or by an internal hosted web server which allows users to access content using a browser of their own choice. XOWA can load and display multiple wikis. It is not limited to just Wikipedia. For instructions on how to download and install it, see the official XOWA webpage . text: Five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport Skip to content Watch Live Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport 2 hours ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google Max Matza Video shows damaged Amazon cargo plane after crash An Amazon Air cargo plane overshot the runway while attempting to land at Miami International Airport, killing five people and seriously injuring five more. The Boeing 767-300 cargo aircraft crashed just before 14:00 local time (19:00 GMT) after departing from Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport in San Juan, Puerto Rico. The flight also hit several vehicles on the ground. Amazon said that it is "working closely with local authorities and officials to understand exactly what happened". All flights were ordered grounded by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) as fire crews raced to the smoking crash site. The crash comes over Labor Day weekend, one of the busiest travel times of the year. "At least five people have lost their lives, and five others are injured," Miami-Dade County Mayor Daniella Levine Cava said at a news conference on Sunday evening. She added that rescue crews arrived at the scene within "seconds" of the crash. "Right now, our focus is on the families, those who were injured, and the ongoing response," she continued. Three of the five people injured are in critical condition, said Miami Fire Chief Raied Jadallah. The mayor said they were all taken to hospital with "unknown injuries". Several of the injured were trapped inside or under vehicles on the ground, and needed to be extricated by fire and rescue crews, said Jadallah. Officials say it is too early to know the cause of the crash, and that it will be investigated by the National Transportation Safety Board. The federal agency, which investigates all air crashes in the US, plans to hold a news conference on Monday. The Amazon flight operated by 21 Air, a charter company based in North Carolina, "overran Miami International Airport's diagonal runway and is disabled at the northwest end of the airport," the airport said in a statement. Miami Dade Fire Rescue said crews "arrived to find an airplane that had caught on fire as a result of this crash, with heavy flames and smoke showing". Getty Images Over 200 firefighters responded to the crash. The flames were extinguished, but there is still a fuel leak at the site, said Jadallah. Amazon issued a statement saying that it is working closely with authorities and offering condolences to the victims. "We're heartbroken to learn that five people lost their lives in today's incident at Miami International Airport," said Kelly Nantel, Amazon's Director of Corporate Global Media Relations. "Our deepest sympathies go out to the families, loved ones, and all those affected by this devastating loss. "The airplane, which was operated by 21 Air, was attempting to land when this incident occurred. We're working closely with local authorities and officials to learn more and will cooperate fully with any investigation." The BBC has emailed 21 Air about the incident, but has not received a response. Flight data from tracking site FlightRadar24 shows that the Amazon cargo flight was travelling at 112 knots (129mph, 207km/h) as it exited the "useable runway". In a blog post, the site says the plane came to rest near a parking lot that services an Amazon warehouse and other businesses. There were light thunderstorms and gusting winds in Miami at the time of the incident, the site says. The crash comes during one of the busiest travel weekends of the year in the US. Passengers at Miami International Airport airport told the BBC they were frustrated by the lack of information coming from officials, with many flights cancelled or delayed as a result of the incident. There were long lines at airline counters as people tried to reschedule travel plans, with some saying they would be forced to stay in Miami an extra night. The Transportation Safety Administration (TSA) said there would be 17 million travellers passing through US airports in the week leading up to Monday's Labor Day holiday. The TSA, which screens passengers flying in the US, predicted that 2.3 million people would fly on Sunday alone. 'Incredibly difficult day' Miami-Dade mayor says after five confirmed dead Miami International Airport (MIA) is located near downtown Miami, and is one of the busiest airports in the country. "Founded in 1928, MIA is America's busiest airport for international freight and second busiest for international passengers, offers more flights to Latin America and the Caribbean than any other US airport," according to their website. About 60% of all international visitors to Florida arrive at this airport, it says.
